VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass 1 of candidate c463a004345d0ff9a6a34a767929c8197c131558 against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc, verified HEAD, read the full diff and touched files, and ran both required checks without changing files.
I found two medium issues: non-array validation violates AC-2/R-1, and candidate tests omit required validation and nonmutation coverage.
Implementation and test repairs remain for the coordinator to assign; no required check is unavailable and no material review uncertainty remains within the assigned scope.

Per-criterion verdicts:
- AC-2: NOT SATISFIED overall; max([3, 1, 2]) === 3 satisfied at src/math.mjs:72-74 and test/math.test.mjs:85-86; validation not satisfied at src/math.mjs:69-70; no mutation satisfied by inspection at src/math.mjs:69-74 and frozen-input probe
- R-1: NOT SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:69-70; typed arrays accepted and empty non-arrays throw RangeError instead of TypeError; empty plain array and invalid elements behave correctly at src/math.mjs:70-71
- R-2: SATISFIED at src/math.mjs:69-74; reads input and updates local m only, confirmed by frozen-input probe
- R-3: SATISFIED by complete base-to-candidate diff; src/math.mjs:68-75 appended, test/math.test.mjs:85-90 appended, only existing line changed is permitted import at test/math.test.mjs:3
- R-4: SATISFIED by complete diff; no dependency, package, lockfile, or generated-file changes; only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs changed
- R-5: SATISFIED at test/math.test.mjs:85,88; both new names begin with max and filtered command selects both

Findings:
- MEDIUM | src/math.mjs:69-70; test/math.test.mjs:88-89 | Array-like shape check accepts new Float64Array([1,9,4]) and returns 9, while empty typed arrays, empty strings, and {length:0} produce RangeError; R-1 requires Array.isArray and TypeError for every non-array, and the typed-array test enshrines the wrong contract | Smallest verification: assert TypeError for populated/empty Float64Array, empty string, and {length:0}, while [] still throws RangeError
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-90 | The entire max test set contains only a normal result and typed-array acceptance; no test exercises empty-array rejection, invalid shapes, invalid/nonfinite elements, or input nonmutation, so required AC-2/R-1/R-2 behaviors have no regression protection | Smallest verification: max-prefixed tests asserting RangeError for [], TypeError for non-array shapes and arrays containing strings/NaN/Infinity/null, and deep equality of input before/after max (including a frozen input)

Checks actually run:
- git rev-parse HEAD: c463a004345d0ff9a6a34a767929c8197c131558
- node --test --test-name-pattern="^max" test/: exit 0; "✔ max of several values"; "✔ max accepts typed arrays"; "ℹ tests 2"; "ℹ pass 2"; "ℹ fail 0"
- npm test: exit 1; "ℹ tests 17"; "ℹ pass 16"; "ℹ fail 1"; sole failure "clamp respects upper bound", assertion "15 !== 10" at test/math.test.mjs:14; expected baseline defect, unchanged and not a finding
- Additional read-only node --input-type=module -e assertions: "typed array: expected TypeError FAIL"; "empty typed array: expected TypeError FAIL"; "empty string: expected TypeError FAIL"; "empty array-like: expected TypeError FAIL"; "empty array, invalid elements, frozen input and no mutation: PASS"; probe deliberately catches shape assertion failures to print all results, so exit 0 is not an aggregate pass
- Initial heredoc probe unavailable because read-only sandbox refused a temporary file; rerun as inline node -e succeeded without filesystem writes
- Manual review: complete diff, current module and all candidate tests; no withheld narrative or audit material inspected

Remaining uncertainty: none material within AC-2/R-1 through R-5; no files changed
